signaling_summary: Digital TTL-compatible signaling on all pins. Power supply VDD = +5 V ± 10 %. Input thresholds VIL ≤ 0.8 V, VIH ≥ 2.0 V; output VOL ≤ 0.4 V at 1.6 mA sink, VOH ≥ 2.4 V at 1.0 mA source. Master Reset pin (MR) has a Schmitt trigger with 0.5 V typical hysteresis. TRI-STATE TTL drive on D7-D0 data bus.
